Summary.en: Replaces the parts of the input value matched by a regular expression.
Summary.de: Ersetzt die Teile des Eingabewerts, die einem regulären Ausdruck entsprechen.
Summary.it: Sostituisce le parti del valore di input corrispondenti a un'espressione regolare.

Parameter.Extractor: The string representing the regular expression to extract the values to be replaced.
Parameter.Replacements: The string representing the replacement value.

Extractor.default: The string representing the regular expression to extract the values to be replaced.

Replacements.default: The string representing the replacement value.
